note: Underground galleries (MIN-A, OD-29; docs/build17/MIN_A_ARCHITECTURE.md), read by Underground (game/scripts/core/underground.gd). Each lies under the surface rock that holds its portal's door; the shape comes from the world seed. Seam amounts are the village map's own per-seam amount for the ore unless 'amount' is given. Tiles are values of the village's atlases (atlas * 100000 + tile id, as in village.json): floor the paid atlas's grey cobbled stone (ROCK_SLAB), wall the hill top's own rock (ROCK_FILL, tools/build_village.py::rock_top). MIN-F/MIN-H: an entry with "kind": "cave" is a natural cave made by the same generator with its own "salt" (its passages are its own), on a deeper level under the same rock, with its own mouth on the surface (its own portal; "mouth" names the village layer and tile its surface door is drawn with: the adit's own opening). Levels stack: the cave (-2) lies under the gallery (-1) and is joined to it by nothing but the hill above. Its floor is the free atlas's plain dirt, shaded (floor_shade). The cave's numbers are agent decisions (docs/build17/MIN_F_UNDERGROUND.md). MIN-F2 (Q2): "hidden" names ore placed by the same generator in each map's deep rock (never beside a floor): not in World.deposits, so nobody knows of it, until a tunnel or a shaft opens a cell beside it (MineWorks: an ordinary seam with host rock, found_<ore>, never refilled). "deep" is the template of a level made below the cave by a shaft (Q4): all rock, its own salt and hidden ore; levels end at mine_works.json shaft.deepest.
